blocks.text: Install Java 17 or later and JBang. Save each example as Lesson.java and run jbang Lesson.java. The //DEPS line lets JBang fetch Spring. These examples use the core container and do not start a web server.

blocks.title: Run cleanup when closing

blocks.text: The try-with-resources block closes the context. Spring then calls the bean cleanup method once.
Add a print before the context closes and compare order.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Cleanup needs the context to close; an abrupt process stop may skip it.
